Further it is submitted that already the proceedings have been initiated under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 and only with an intention to take revenge, the present compliant has been filed.
It is his further submission that already this Court under similar facts and circumstances of the case has allowed the petition in W.P. No.29499/2017 dated 06.01.2020 and quashed the proceedings.

However, he fairly submits that in pursuance of Section 5 of the Act, the aggrieved person ought to have filed a private complaint, but instead of filing a private complaint, the information has been given to the police.
On these grounds, he prayed to dismiss the petition.
